settings.success_text: Thank you. You will hear back within two working days.

settings.text: A question before you join, a group price, or trouble with a lesson. It all comes to the same inbox.

settings.question: Do I need to be good with numbers?
settings.answer: No. If you can add up a shopping receipt, you can do this course. The spreadsheet does the sums.

settings.question: Do I need to buy an app?
settings.answer: No. Everything runs in a free spreadsheet app, or on the printed workbook if you prefer paper.

settings.question: How much time does it take?
settings.answer: About twenty minutes a day: a short lesson and one small task. You can pause and pick it up a week later.

settings.question: How do the live calls work?
settings.answer: Send a question by Wednesday. On Thursday evening Nina answers them on a video call. Recordings stay in the course. This is teaching, not personal financial advice.

settings.question: What if it is not for me?
settings.answer: Write within 30 days and you get every cent back. Replace this with your own terms.
